assigned_fix.root_cause: Recurrence of docs/rca/cases/2026-10-25-demo-replay-worker-cpu-starvation-normalization-and-live-jev.md. The single cloud worker's event loop was CPU-saturated during the 50-agent DEMO fan-out by per-turn O(turns^2) work: (1) re-redacting every earlier tool result, 13.8%; (2) rebuilding both schema projections, 16.5%; (3) a per-call httpx client SSLContext, 8.4%. Temporal-started post_agent_message attempts 2 and 3 began their bodies late and hit StartToClose without sending a request, so the completed explore surfaced as a spawn_agent ERROR.
assigned_fix.fix: Bounded redaction memo; weak-keyed schema projections per model class; pooled client for the compute-token lease and heartbeat; activity.dispatch_lag worker interceptor (observability).
assigned_fix.pre_fix: Regressions FAIL on 818f3669 (24 extra redaction passes and 16 schema rebuilds over 4 re-renders; 6 per-call AsyncClients; 20/20 per-turn classes retained). Exact local task with guest worker settings at CPUQuota=100%: buggy FAIL 'Timeout after 902s' with 331 activity timeouts and dispatch lag p50/max 23.6/39.2s (FE agent 23492d9d-8164-4245-b383-e26f8d70a87e); earlier 500-slot pair buggy FAIL 905s with 3x 'Tool spawn_agent failed: activity StartToClose timeout' (agent 7869a0c8).

The deploy smoke on a6353fb and on d3a8bd2f passed test-mass-agent-run-0 with 0 activity timeouts; guest post_agent_message lag max 15.6s.
